Class SceneManager

java.lang.Object
core.SceneManager
public class SceneManager extends Object
Manages the transitions between different scenes (screens) in the application.

This class handles creating, caching, and switching between the main menu, the map selection screen, and the active game scene. It also ensures that audio and scaling updates are applied appropriately during these transitions.

    • goToMapSelection

      public void goToMapSelection()
      Transitions the application to the map selection screen.

      If the screen has not been created yet, it initializes and caches it. It also refreshes the map buttons (to reflect newly unlocked maps), updates the background music, and resizes/centers the window.

    • goToMainGame

      public void goToMainGame(GameMap selectedMap)
      Transitions the application to the main game screen for a specific map.

      Unlike menus, the game scene is newly instantiated each time it is loaded to ensure a fresh game state. It also triggers the battle music and resizes/centers the window.

      Parameters:
      selectedMap - The GameMap the player has chosen to play.

    • goToMainMenu

      public void goToMainMenu()
      Transitions the application to the starting main menu screen.

      If the main menu has not been created yet, it initializes and caches it, applying the global scaling settings. It also sets the menu music and resizes/centers the window.
